name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Acrylic Graduation Cap Topper
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic material, offering a bright, modern, and eye-catching finish.
    - Features a 2-layer acrylic construction that creates a stylish, dimensional effect and enhances the overall graduation cap decoration.
    - Layer 1 uses acrylic thickness 1mm, helping keep the topper lightweight and easy to place on the cap.
    - Layer 2 uses acrylic thickness 2mm, adding depth and highlighting custom-shaped decorative elements.
    - Reinforced with 4 hook-and-loop dots, allowing flexible attachment and more secure placement on the graduation cap.
    - Includes a center hole with a diameter of 2 cm ~ 0.79 in for tassel placement.
    - Graduation cap is not included.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes: 
                     +) 9.5 x 9.5 in ~ 24.13 x 24.13 cm.
                     +) 7.5 x 7.5 in ~ 19.05 x 19.05 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Layer 1 supports 1-sided printing for the main cap topper design.
    - Layer 2 supports 1-sided printing for custom-shaped decorative elements, creating a standout layered effect.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized graduation cap decoration and memorable keepsake.
    - Designed to attach securely to graduation caps using reinforced hook-and-loop dots.
    - Includes a center hole for easy tassel placement and convenient setup.
    - Lightweight construction helps decorate the cap without adding too much weight.
    - Perfect for graduation ceremonies, photo sessions, celebration parties, and memory preservation.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for graduates, students, family members, and friends.
    - Perfect for kindergarten, high school, college, and university graduation celebrations.
    - Ideal for creating a unique cap design that stands out during ceremonies and photos.
    - A thoughtful keepsake to celebrate academic milestones and personal achievements.
    - Great for graduation parties, senior events, and commemorative gifts.
    - Adds a fun, personal, and unforgettable touch to graduation day 🎁 🎁🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 xCustom Shape 2-Layer Acrylic Graduation Cap Topper

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
